name: Mary Maddux
reason: No sign she still teaches: the Meditation Oasis podcast stopped in May 2020, the blog in 2020, the apps were last updated in 2021, her last Insight Timer upload was about three years ago, and her site still carries pandemic-era notices with no classes, courses or new work; much of the catalogue is also framed around anxiety, sleep problems and illness. Worth a human look as a possible luminary-tier legacy listing (174.7k Insight Timer followers; email meditate@meditationoasis.com published on meditationoasis.com/contact) if inactive teachers are ever accepted.
